text: Happy 34th birthday to the talented Manni Perez, who plays Lucia in GTA 6. @RockstarGames 😠
Character switching comparison: - GTA V (PS3 - 2013): 15 seconds - GTA VI (PS5 - 2026): 6 seconds @RockstarGames 😠

Miami is proposing to allow Rockstar to place GTA 6 billboards around the city starting October 15: - Maximum of six banners would be allowed between October 15 and December 31 - Rockstar would pay $202,000 per banner ($1.2 million total) - The promotional displays still need approval from Take-Two Interactive (Source: https://www.themiamian.net/p/miami-wants-to-get-in-on-the-vice-city-action ) @RockstarGames 😠

The effects of the GTA 6 Extended Look: • It became the #1 most watched title in 87 countries on Netflix • Pre-orders increased 606% on PS5 and 127% on Xbox • PS5 and Xbox console sales jumped 33% in the UK • PS5 Pro sold out at many major retailers in the US • 2 of the songs featured in the trailer had the biggest increase in streams: “Se Me Nota (Agárrame)” with 3,047% and “Inner Light” with 462%, and both reached the top 10 on Shazam’s US Top 200 chart @RockstarGames 😠
